channel.title: Generative AI news and analysis | TechCrunch

item.title: Amazon to begin testing AI tools for film and TV production next month
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios will reportedly begin a closed beta program in March to test its AI tools to help with film and TV production.

item.title: Roblox’s 4D creation feature is now available in open beta
item.description: Roblox's highly anticipated 4D creation feature has officially arrived in open beta.

item.title: Firefox will soon let you block all of its generative AI features
item.description: Starting with Firefox 148 arriving later this month, users will find a new AI controls section within the desktop browser settings.

item.title: Node-based design tool Flora raises $42M from Redpoint Ventures
item.description: Flora lets customers use image, text, or video to create media assets, including images and video. Users can also use prompts to create modifications to build new nodes with multiple iterations. These generated versions are mapped with each other on a canvas to give you a tractable flow of creation.

item.title: Slackbot is an AI agent now
item.description: Salesforce unveils Slackbot, a new AI agent that allows users to complete tasks across multiple enterprise applications from Slack.

item.title: Google Classroom’s new tool uses Gemini to transform lessons into podcast episodes
item.description: Google Classroom now offers a Gemini-powered tool that generates podcast-style audio lessons for teachers to deepen engagement with students.

item.title: ChatGPT: A 2025 timeline of updates to OpenAI’s text-generating chatbot
item.description: A timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.

item.title: Alexa+ comes to the Amazon Music app
item.description: The feature is currently available across all Amazon Music subscription plans but is only available for users with Alexa+ Early Access.

item.title: Instagram users can now use Meta AI editing tools directly in IG Stories
item.description: Meta AI's photo editing tools can be found in Instagram Stories when tapping the paintbrush icon. Users can describe what they want to add, remove, or change.

item.title: Adobe launches a foundry service that builds custom generative AI models for enterprises
item.description: Adobe will build custom AI models by training its Firefly model family on a brand's intellectual property.

item.title: Meta Llama: Everything you need to know about the open generative AI model
item.description: Here's everything you need to know about Meta’s Llama, from its capabilities and editions to where you can use it. We'll keep this post updated as Meta releases upgrades and introduces new dev tools to support the model's use.

item.title: Creative machines and where AI meets imagination at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025
item.description: Discover how AI is co-creating the future of storytelling, video, and animation at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025, with Prateek Dixit, Nikola Todorovic, and Soyoung Lee. Join with a group and save up to 20%, or register yourself to save up to $444.

item.title: DeepSeek: Everything you need to know about the AI chatbot app
item.description: DeepSeek is backed by High-Flyer Capital Management, a Chinese quantitative hedge fund that uses AI to inform its trading decisions.

item.title: Captions rebrands as Mirage, expands beyond creator tools to AI video research
item.description: Captions, the AI-powered video creation and editing app for content creators, is rebranding to Mirage.

item.title: Former Googlers’ AI startup OpenArt now creates ‘brain rot’ videos in just one click
item.description: OpenArt launched a new feature to help creators make AI-generated brain rot videos.

item.title: DeepMind thinks its new Genie 3 world model presents a stepping stone toward AGI
item.description: Google DeepMind has revealed Genie 3, its latest foundation world model that the AI lab says presents a crucial stepping stone on the path to artificial general intelligence, or human-like intelligence.

item.title: GenAI apps doubled their revenue, grew to 1.7B downloads in first half of 2025
item.description: People are downloading and spending money on GenAI apps more than ever.

item.title: German data protection official wants Apple, Google to remove DeepSeek from the country’s app stores
item.description: Germany has told Apple and Google to remove Chinese AI app DeepSeek from their app stores, saying the company transfers users' data to China illegally.

item.title: Elon dips from DOGE, and Silicon Valley enters the ‘find out’ stage
item.description: Elon Musk has officially announced he’s stepping down as a U.S. special government employee and the de facto head of the Department of Government Efficiency, better known as DOGE.  The move follows Musk’s cooling relationship with the Trump administration and slumping Tesla sales tied to his political advocacy. item.title: The New York Times and Amazon ink AI licensing deal
item.description: Nearly two years after suing OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement, The New York Times has agreed to license its editorial content to Amazon to train the tech giant’s AI platforms.
